name: Huntington
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Huntington, NY 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Huntington, NY for 2026: the free Holiday Spectacular with a tree lighting, light shows and Santa on Wall Street.
lede: Huntington Village puts its Christmas on Wall Street, where the Holiday Spectacular lights the tree and then runs hourly light shows and Santa visits.
celebrates: The Huntington Holiday Spectacular opens with a Tree Lighting Celebration on Saturday, November 28, at 12 Wall Street in Huntington Village, presented by Northwell Huntington Hospital and the Huntington Village BID. After the lighting, the Spectacular runs hourly 30 minute light shows and Santa visits at the tree, and its calendar adds live music, dance showcases, farmers markets and a Holiday Art Markets series. The host says every event on the calendar is free, which makes it an easy stop for families who want holiday lights without buying tickets.
lastyear: The Holiday Spectacular's own social page for the previous year announced a Saturday, November 29 tree lighting, with a parade starting at 5:30 pm at Home Depot and the lighting immediately following at 6:30 pm. In 2023 the festivities kicked off on Saturday, November 25 with a well attended tree lighting celebration, according to the Living Huntington event listing. The Spectacular has been a Wall Street fixture for years, and a North Shore Leader story reports a year when it returned to its traditional Wall Street location.
facts: Wall Street between Main Street and Gerard Street is the hub of the Holiday Spectacular, and the same stretch hosts the annual Huntington menorah lighting. The Spectacular has a daily schedule that changes by weekday: light shows begin at 5 pm Monday to Friday and at noon on Saturday and Sunday. The host lists Santa visits on many dates and asks families to RSVP on its website for some of them.
trains: Ride the rails to the holidays. The MTA says the Long Island Rail Road's Holiday Lights Train, a locomotive covered in thousands of lights, runs along all electric branches from Monday, November 23 into January, so families who ride the LIRR this season may spot it. Check the LIRR timetable before you plan a train trip to the events on this page, and bring the children to the window to look for the glowing locomotive.
traditions: The kickoff on Wall Street in Huntington Village.

kidfact: Huntington's light show repeats every hour, so kids who miss one can catch the next.
faq: The Huntington Village BID's Holiday Spectacular lights a tree on Wall Street and then runs hourly light shows, Santa visits, music, markets and dance showcases through December, all listed as free.
Is the Huntington Holiday Spectacular free?
Yes. The host says every event on its calendar is free, including the tree lighting, the light shows and the Santa visits.
When is the Huntington tree lighting in 2026?
Saturday, November 28, 2026, from about 6:30 to 10 pm at 12 Wall Street, according to the Huntington Village BID.
Where can kids meet Santa in Huntington?
Santa visits the tree on Wall Street on dates the Holiday Spectacular lists, including Sunday, December 20 from noon to 4 pm. Some visits ask families to RSVP on the host's website.
